title: Kuroko’s Basketball
description: In the story, Kagami Taiga has just enrolled into Seirin High School when he meets Kuroko Tetsuya of the school’s basketball team. Kuroko happens to be the shadowy sixth member of the legendary Generation of Miracles basketball team. Together, Kagami and Kuroko aim to take their team to the inter-high school championship – against Kuroko’s former teammates.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 0 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Animated bloopers, based on the extra section of the original manga series, included with the BD/DVD series for Kuroko no Basket (both limited and normal editions).

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: While recruiting for the basketball club, the Seirin Private High school has managed to pick up some impressive players; a power house, former American player, and a member of the “Generation of Miracles.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Before anyone can become an official member of the Basketball Club, they first must do display courage. Afterwards, a surprising guest appears on the school grounds with a shocking offer.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Seirin basketball club is playing a practice game at Kaijo High School, the school where Kise attends. After a display of power from Kagami, it forces the Kaijo coach to take Seirin serious.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: The only way to stop Kise is to challenge him with a style he can't copy, Kurokos! The new offensive from Seirin is closing the point gap, until an injury might derail Serin's chance at victory.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Serin is victorious against Kaijo, barely.  It is a shock to Kise, who has never lost in his life. After the game, another former Teiko Middle school player, Midorima, has a few words for Kise.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Serins first opponent in the inter-high tournament is Shinkyo high, a middle tier school until last year.  With the addition of a two meter tall, 87 kilogram player from Senegal, Shinkyo is a new threat to Serins championship hopes.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After their win over Shinkyo, Seirin goes on to crush their next few opponents. Realizing too much confidence is brewing, the team is taken to watch a Shutoku match. After seeing how Shutoku, one of the three Emperor teams of basketball, dominates their opposition, the team realizes they have a long way to go if they are to improve and contend for the title.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Seirin takes on Seiho, a squad built around an invincible defense. The unorthodox manner in the way Seiko moves is finally understood, but it may be too late. Will Seirin's streak finally be shutdown?

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Seirin's game continues against Seiho with neither team giving up points.  Kuroko and Kagami are pulled after the first quarter, to preserve their strength. Can their team mates bring home the victory?

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Kuroko has rejoined the game in the final moments, but it seems that one of the players has him figured out. Seirin is playing hard, but if they win, will they have the strength to play a 2nd game

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Seirin is holding their own against Shutoku, but in the 2nd half Midorima and Takao’s abilities are unleashed, shutting down Seirin’s game completely

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The pressure of the game is causing Kagami skills to rapidly increase; he continues to score keeping Seirin in the game. But his thoughts are turning darker and self-serving

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: With only 10 minutes left, Seirin is in trouble.  Kagami has run out of gas and Midorima shows no sign of stopping.  Kuroko is back in the game with a new, but dangerous pass.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: After an awkward dinner involving rival basketball teams, Kuroko happens upon a dog that looks just like him. The dog quickly gathered favor with everybody except for one.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Kuroko explains part of the history of the "Generation of Miracle" to Kagami.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Even without Aomine, Touou Academy is dominating against Seirin.  It is an uphill battle against Touou Academy individual style of play and the genius of Satsuki.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: In a few minutes of play, Aomie has demonstrated why he is a force to be reckoned with, with Kuroko benched in the 2nd half, will the team be able to hold Aomie off?

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Aomie is unstoppable, but Serin hasn't given up yet. But with Kagami pulled in the last few minutes, can the team play without him?

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: The only thing you can do is pick yourself up and move on. Some can move on faster, while others wallow in their own darkness. A new beginning and an old friend is what needed to pick the team back up.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Kiyoshi has a plan for Kuroko and Kagami to get them over their slump. Kuroko, on the other hand, think he needs to be pulled.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The training camp from hell has begun.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: The training camp is over and everyone has learned something about themselves. But the team is not ready to leave yet, as there is a game happening: Kaijo vs Touou, Kise Ryota vs Aomine Daiki.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Kise copy technique has lead Kaijo to take the early lead. With Touou keeping pace, Aomine is enjoying the pressure and is getting better each minute.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Touou Academy has not stolen the game like expected. If they can’t break away, Kise will finally reach full potential.

episodes_data.title: Kuroko’s Basketball Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The game has reached a fever pitch and some of the players are about to break. Can Kise keep up copy of Aomine or will Aomine finally be able to go all out.
